title: Codify the triage direct-session operating mode: self-timed rounds, transcript-verified verdict subagents, Director backstop
body:
Fixes #12706

Codifies the six maintainer rulings recorded on the card (2026-08-27) into the pm-dispatch governed protocol text. All ruling quotes verbatim, untranslated.

## The six rulings

1. **Triage seat = normal direct session, whole seat at opus.** 「我觉得分诊也和普通项目经理一样走普通的session，然后需要高级别处理的任务走 fable 子agent，然后自己默认定时1小时，除非人工要求。」 The mechanical trio (hourly sweep, unlock scan, half-state healing) needs at most opus; the tier analysis is on the card.
2. **Tier-gated duties (proxy-adjudication, Clause-②/contract-review increments) run via a `claude-fable-5` subagent dispatched with explicit `model`** — the dispatch-param mechanism, not session self-introspection.
3. **Transcript tier verification.** Before any verdict is adopted or any label cleared, the dispatching session greps the subagent's transcript for the per-message API-stamped `model` field; every verdict-producing turn must read `claude-fable-5`; fallback evidence voids the verdict (redo or maintainer path). Dispatch params are configuration; the fuse measures serving.
4. **No-edit guardrail.** The opus parent has exactly two legal actions on a fable verdict — adopt verbatim, or void whole (void reasons mechanical only: tier verification failed / scope exceeded / format incomplete). Never rewrite, trim, or "improve" verdict content; acceptance = evidence checklist, never substantive re-judgment.
5. **Self-timer default = armed at round END, delay at most 55 minutes** (the 1-hour prompt-cache TTL minus measured minutes-level timer jitter keeps the shift on one cache chain; two boundaries recorded as a note: usage-overage drops the TTL to 5 minutes and the benefit to zero, and compaction rounds rewrite regardless — neither changes the default). Overridable by explicit maintainer request. The five-piece package was approved whole: 「同意，重新汇总给我解释一下新的分诊项目经理完整的工作。」
6. **Chain timed-processing split.** 「契约复审也是很重要的职责，也是需要定时处理的」, approved 「同意，继续」: standing contract-review processing = the triage timed round; every round report carries the 复审清单 (same mandatory-audit shape as the 代裁清单); the Director seat = summon-time backstop (only carriers triage explicitly parked, failed tier-verification on, or aged out) plus the BLOCKED branch inside adjudication batches; anti-double-run hard line — the standing processor is uniquely the triage timed round.

## Per-file clause rewrites

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`** (1005 lines before and after)
- 「座位 Routine 三原则」 paragraph rewritten to 「分诊席直连自排」 (pieces 1 and 5, full ruling quote carried); the round-open mutex/release text from the shift-close ruling is kept verbatim inside the same paragraph.
- 代裁通道 clause: runner set restated at pointer altitude — verdicts only from a tier-proven producer: the triage seat's explicit-`model` fable subagent, each verdict past transcript verification (2026-08-27 裁), or the at-tier Director seat; mechanics live in `references/contract-review.md`. The 2026-08-26 hard-gate quote and the 2026-08-12 confidence-gate conditions are unchanged.
- Consistency touches: the role-arg sentence (Routine-rebuild vocabulary retired), 席位档策略 (the triage seat joins the opus-session default; fable reserved for verdict/review subagents, the skills seat and Clause-② work; Routine-UI-pin wording retired), urgent-triage wording (Routine 班次 → 定时轮次), and the daily low-frequency subround owner (分诊 Routine → 分诊席).

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md`** (48 lines before and after)
- 资格 clause: the machine reading splits by path — own-session via the downgrade fuse, subagent path via transcript tier verification.
- 归属 clause: standing owner uniquely = the triage timed round via verified subagent; PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED branch endings; 复审清单 in every round report; Director = summon backstop plus the BLOCKED branch; the anti-double-run hard line.
- The ⛔ 反模式 paragraph became the 转录档位核验 bullet: the higher-tier-subagent review path WAS constructively unmeasurable and is legal exactly when transcript verification passes; the get_session-measures-the-dispatching-session measurement stays as the reason introspection or params alone remain inadmissible; the no-edit guardrail (adopt verbatim or void whole; three mechanical void reasons) lands in the same bullet.
- Fail-safe unchanged: the opening get_session fuse bullet and the no-quota-exemption bullet stay (wording compressed only).

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md`** (75 lines before and after)
- 授权与形态: parking-between-summons now covers decision cards and the audit window only (review carriers' standing timed processing moved to the triage round).
- 职责一 reframed as the backstop: only parked / failed-verification / aged-out carriers plus the BLOCKED branch; never sweeps the timed round's carrier set in parallel. The 处理三分支 ruling text is untouched.
- 职责二: runner-set wording 分诊 Routine → 分诊席.
- 交接台账: the two supersession bullets merged into one dated chain (dead hourly clock → director summon → 2026-08-27: standing = triage timed round, director = backstop).

## Cut ledger (net 0 per file; every cut names its surviving home)

SKILL.md:
1. Old 三原则 items ① and ② (Routines-UI creation, UI model pin, manual fire smoke test) — retired by the ruling itself; the obsolete Routine's UI disable is already filed as its own pm:awaiting-maintainer item.
2. Old item ③ (per-fire rebuild from labels, no context inheritance) — survives in 全体座位的不变量, first bullet (all state on GitHub; the loop must recover from a fresh session).
3. 「⛔ 永不靠重建Routine 改行为」 — retired with the Routine; the surviving half (behaviour versioned in git, upgrades via skill PR) kept in place.
4. Sanitizer bullet: the dispatch-order incident illustration and the standalone read-back framing — write-side shapes and the read-back duty live in `references/platform-readings.md` (写侧 sanitizer 条款); incident case law lives in git history per house rules.
5. Gate-verdict bullet detail (in_progress does not count; aggregate only as negative screening; read the single job by name, never the full table) — verbatim home in `references/platform-readings.md` (状态核验/门禁放行判据 entry).
6. Wall-detection bullet: the ccusage single-container-view detail — home in `references/platform-readings.md` (断粮检测 section); the fact-table pointer stays in the bullet.
7. 代裁通道 clause: the literal serving-model spelling plus 「(钉档)」 — replaced by the ruled subagent mechanism; the machine-reading requirement survives as the transcript-verification pointer, and 「⛔ 永不凭自述」 is kept in place.

contract-review.md:
1. 出处 paragraph compressed in place (nothing dropped; the tier-constant name still appears in the fuse section).
2. 重挂前先查裁决 compressed in place (all three verdict conditions kept).
3. Old 归属 dead-clock note and 「常设 = 项目总监席人工召唤」 — superseded by ruling 6; the supersession chain is recorded in `references/lanes/director.md` 交接台账.
4. 「分诊席达档时照旧可清」 — dead under ruling 1 (the triage seat is opus by design; it clears via the verified subagent).
5. 清标即落地: the landing-precheck parenthetical (mergeable_state first, closing-keyword scan, true-green job conclusions, ready before arm) — verbatim home in `references/landing-operations.md` section B.
6. The get_session dual-reading same-source note — home in `references/platform-readings.md` (读数陷阱, get_session entry).
7. 「派发席不写代码」 rationale — home in SKILL.md 全体座位的不变量 (PM 不写文件、不写代码).
8. The old 反模式 refusal measurement (subagent read back the parent tier and refused to produce a verdict) — the parent-tier read-back half is kept in the fuse bullet; the refusal detail is subsumed by the now-legal verified path.

director.md:
1. 职责一 review-process arrows (enumerate → review the diff → one-line conclusion → PASS clears both carriers) — home in `../contract-review.md` (归属 and 载体纪律), pointed at by the same bullet.
2. 交接台账 runner-set spelling history — compressed into the dated chain in the merged bullet; both quotes kept.

The last gate refused twice with PREREQUISITE NOT MET (unbuilt @objectstack/formula, then @objectstack/lint) — both recorded as NOT MEASURED, both packages built, gate re-run green.

## Acceptance replay — one triage round under the new text

1. Round open: the mutex four readings run unchanged; the round-open marker lands on the seat post; the cheapest inventory probe goes first.
2. The mechanical trio runs at opus inside the direct session (sweep, unlock scan, half-state healing) — no tier gate is touched.
3. One contract-review carrier and one adjudicable decision card: a `claude-fable-5` subagent is dispatched with explicit `model` per task; before adopting either verdict or clearing any label, the session greps the subagent transcript's per-message `model` field — every verdict-producing turn reads the contract-review tier, and a fallback stamp voids that verdict whole (redo or maintainer path); the parent adopts verbatim or voids whole, never edits.
4. The round report carries both the 复审清单 and the 代裁清单 as mandatory-audit sections.
5. Round end: the self-timer is armed with delay at most 55 minutes; the shift stays on one prompt-cache chain; an explicit maintainer request overrides the default.

## Not touched

seat-post-protocol.md (pointed at, not edited), decision-analysis.md, state-machine.md, every script, the four-copy decision frame, the governed-surface namings. Fail-safe direction intact everywhere: unverifiable ⇒ skip/void, never self-report; the Director's own get_session fuse for its direct-session duties stays as-is.

Draft on purpose — the diff touches a governed surface (.claude/skills), human merge only. skip-changeset: internal agent instruction text, nothing publishes.
